API Reference

This section documents the primary modules used by the GradCafe Analytics application.

Scraping

scrape.build_results_url(page_number=1)

Build a GradCafe results URL for a specific page.

scrape.check_robots_txt(target_url)

Check whether robots.txt allows access to the target URL.

scrape.load_data(filename='applicant_data.json')

Load applicant data from a JSON file.

scrape.main()
scrape.save_data(data, filename='applicant_data.json')

Save applicant data to a JSON file.
